Q250011.description: which team the player was drafted by

Q250011.label: family name
Q250011.description: part of full name of person

Q250011.label: given name
Q250011.description: first name or another given name of this person; values used with the property should not link disambiguations nor family names

Q250011.label: social media followers
Q250011.description: number of subscribers on a particular social media website (use as main statement only; see P3744 instead for qualifier). Qualify with "point in time" and property for account. For Twitter, use numeric id.

Q2500814.label: field of work
Q2500814.description: specialization of a person or organization; see P106 for the occupation

Q2500814.label: occupation
Q2500814.description: occupation of a person; see also "field of work" (Property:P101), "position held" (Property:P39)

Q2500814.label: employer
Q2500814.description: person or organization for which the subject works or worked

Q2500814.label: signature
Q2500814.description: image of a person's signature

Q2500814.label: place of burial
Q2500814.description: location of grave, resting place, place of ash-scattering, etc. (e.g., town/city or cemetery) for a person or animal. There may be several places: e.g., re-burials, parts of body buried separately.

Q2500814.label: award received
Q2500814.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

Q2500814.label: image
Q2500814.description: image of relevant illustration of the subject; if available, also use more specific properties (sample: coat of arms image, locator map, flag image, signature image, logo image, collage image)

Q2500814.label: place of birth
Q2500814.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) birth location of a person, animal or fictional character

Q2500814.label: place of death
Q2500814.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) death location of a person, animal or fictional character

Q2500814.label: sex or gender
Q2500814.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

Q2500814.label: spouse
Q2500814.description: the subject has the object as their spouse (husband, wife, partner, etc.). Use "unmarried partner" (P451) for non-married companions

Q2500814.label: country of citizenship
Q2500814.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

Q2500814.label: instance of
Q2500814.description: that class of which this subject is a particular example and member; different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain (and an instance of volcanic landform)

Q2500814.label: child
Q2500814.description: subject has object as child. Do not use for stepchildren—use "relative" (P1038), qualified with "type of kinship" (P1039)

Q2500814.label: family
Q2500814.description: family, including dynasty and nobility houses. Not family name (use P734 for family name).

Q2500814.label: educated at
Q2500814.description: educational institution attended by subject

Q2500814.label: languages spoken, written or signed
Q2500814.description: language(s) that a person or a people speaks, writes or signs, including the native language(s)

Q2500814.label: Commons Creator page
Q2500814.description: name of Commons Infobox template residing in "Creator" namespace on Wikimedia Commons

Q2500814.label: Commons category
Q2500814.description: name of the Wikimedia Commons category containing files related to this item (without the prefix "Category:")

Q2500814.label: academic degree
Q2500814.description: academic degree that the person holds

Q2500814.label: date of birth
Q2500814.description: date on which the subject was born

Q2500814.label: date of death
Q2500814.description: date on which the subject died

Q2500814.label: given name
Q2500814.description: first name or another given name of this person; values used with the property should not link disambiguations nor family names

Q2500814.description: main Wikimedia category
